outputs.first_body:
Rain rereads the account line and writes its reference beside the request.

"Then I can arrange the second tray from this allowance. I will keep the order with the bill, so that there is no confusion afterward. Iris-sama, shall I ask for the same number of portions as before?"

Her attention moves from the bill to the small practical arrangements, rather than to finding money of her own.

Rain keeps a finger on the deduction line instead of passing the request onward.

"Iris-sama, I am sorry, but that would come out of the money I must keep for my family. We already have enough for everyone. Could we use the simple tea today? If an extra tray is needed, I must ask whether the household will pay for it before I order."

She holds the paper, waiting for an answer rather than authorizing the deduction.

Rain steps into the doorway and raises a hand to keep the visitor from passing. She looks back at Claire instead of meeting his eyes.

"Claire-sama, there is no order to hold him, and I know he has finished his business. This will cause trouble if he complains. But... I will have him remain while you speak to him. Please make it brief. I cannot keep explaining it afterward."

Her warning has become a request to shorten the imposition, while she is already helping impose it.
